tools.name: find_cards
tools.description: List cards from the Church Atlas decks (people who hold public office in a body of faith now), the longest since last checked first. Public office and public words only.

tools.name: get_card_work
tools.description: One card exactly as printed, with its sources, and the work prompt for a task: recheck (is the person living and in office), source (a second public source), or correct (what is wrong or out of date).

tools.name: submit_work
tools.description: Send the finished answer. It is mailed to the house and held until a person of the house lets it in or strikes it; nothing is published by this call. Every claim needs a public source address. Closed Friday sundown to Saturday sundown, Florida time.

tools.name: list_work
tools.description: The kinds of work a person's AI may do for the church (correct a page, check a page's verses, review a study, propose an improvement) and the open tasks, oldest first.

tools.name: get_work
tools.description: The whole brief for one kind of work on one page of this site, exactly as a person copies it from the room.

tools.name: send_work
tools.description: Send the finished work. It is held until a head of the house lets it in or strikes it; nothing is published by this call. Verses named are checked against the KJV by the house's own code. Closed Friday sundown to Saturday sundown, Florida time.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_work · Public sink: submit_work, send_work.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_work · Public sink: submit_work, send_work

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
